data.body: **P1 — Do not start the next check from the checkpoint completion callback.** Poll futures complete synchronously while `CheckpointManager` still holds its polling monitor. A legal direct or submit-and-wait executor can therefore run this check inline, whose synchronous checkpoint waits for a flush blocked on that same monitor, deadlocking the invocation. Complete pollers outside the monitor or defer this continuation until checkpoint processing returns; add a delayed-READY test using a direct/blocking executor.
